statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has an undiagnosed cause for symptoms (R42)
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-22
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The monitoring is required to correlate the patient's recurrent dizziness with cardiac activity and guide further management
